data.name: Thedrick
data.gender_notes: Thedrick is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Theo- (God) and drick (rule, power). In Greek mythology, Thedoros was a name for a god of fertility and growth. In the Christian context, Thedric or Thedrick is a name for a person who aspires to God's rule and power in their life. The name Thedrick carries the meaning “God's rule, power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thedrick usually hope their child will grow to embody god's rule, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
